name: Full Smile
verdict: The biggest movement is a 94.74% drop in leads over the last 7 days, likely driven by at least one zero-spend day flagged in the period, which severely disrupted Meta delivery. Despite a solid 28-day base of 77 leads at a $8.60 CPL, the spend pullback of 27.77% compounded the lead decline and sent CPL spiking 1,272.33% week-over-week.

performance.verdict: Zero-spend days killed delivery; SOW milestones 7+ weeks overdue threaten renewal.

findings.text: zero_spend_day flag confirmed: Sep 12, 13, and 16 all show $0 spend and 0 leads — a 3-day delivery blackout, not a single-day anomaly.
CPL spiked 1,272% 7d vs prior 7d; the 28-day baseline CPL is $8.60, meaning the last 7 days produced near-zero leads at effectively infinite cost.
5 overdue SOW milestones (oldest: Jul 23 renewal, latest: Aug 31 dashboard + scoreboard decision) remain undelivered; renewal is month-to-month with explicit walk risk.
GBP actions collapsed 63% 7d and show 0 for Sep 13–16 in series, mirroring the paid blackout — organic visibility is also disrupted, compounding lead loss.
GHL shows 79 opps created and 331 contacts but 0 appointments and 0 won — intake pipeline is stalled; leads arriving but not converting to booked patients is an intake/CRM issue, not an ads problem.

suggestions.text: Restore Meta spend immediately — diagnose why $0 posted Sep 12, 13, 16 and confirm daily budget is live at prior ~$25–33/day.
suggestions.monday_update: Meta recorded $0 spend on Sep 12, 13, and 16, wiping all leads and sending 7-day CPL up 1,272% vs the $8.60 baseline. Confirm the account is not paused, payment method is valid, and the campaign is actively delivering. Success check: spend resumes at $25–33/day and leads return within 3 days (by Sep 20). Escalate to Sohib immediately if the account is suspended.

suggestions.text: Escalate 5 overdue SOW milestones to Nacer/Sohib — dashboard and scoreboard were due Aug 31, directly blocking renewal decision.
suggestions.monday_update: Five milestones are overdue by 17–55 days, including the Aug 31 dashboard and the client's stay/walk scoreboard — the client's stated renewal condition. Nacer and Sohib must confirm current status on each item and deliver the dashboard before the next client touchpoint. Success check: all 5 milestones marked complete or have a committed delivery date confirmed in writing by Sep 20.

suggestions.text: Watch GHL pipeline: 79 opps, 0 appointments, 0 won — confirm intake process with Lily before attributing to ads. Re-check Sep 20.
suggestions.monday_update: GHL shows 79 opportunities created and 331 contacts but zero appointments booked and zero won in the 28-day window. This gap between leads and booked patients is the client's primary scoreboard metric. Sync with Lily (front desk) to confirm whether the new intake hire is operational and whether inbound leads are being followed up. Re-check appointment count and pipeline stage movement by Sep 20.
